claim_text: The d^4-to-d^3 improvement comes from integration by parts that transfers one derivative from a three-logarithmic-derivative contribution onto the coupling, leaving second-order kernel differentiation.
acceptance_criteria: A nonzero third-derivative heat-kernel integral equals the transferred second-derivative-times-coupling-score integral.
Independent analytic convolution derivatives match numerical quadrature.
SymPy confirms kernel polynomial order changes from three to two while the coupling score carries one derivative.
The exact current source factor is O(d^3) and the cited prior factor is O(d^4).
